An AI Meetings Assistant That Automatically Takes Notes and Creates To-Do's to Ensure Nothing Gets Missed
Send Next Steps to Slack, Asana, HubSpot & More
Get lifetime access to Notepik, an AI meeting assistant that turns every call into a summary, a decision log, and action items with a suggested owner and due date. Your workspace gets 3 seats and 5 hours of meetings every month, renewing for life with no recurring fees.
A visible Notepik bot joins your Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Webex calls from a link or your Google or Microsoft calendar. If you’d rather not use a bot, the Chrome extension records the call in your browser tab, and you can also upload recordings up to 2GB. Notepik runs in any modern browser on desktop or phone, so there’s no separate app to install and no device limit.
A transcript tells you what was said; Notepik focuses on what happens next. Action items go straight to Slack, Asana, Trello, ClickUp, and HubSpot, or to other tools through webhooks with Zapier, Make, or n8n. When you need to recall a decision, ask a question across every past meeting and get an answer that cites the meeting and the moment.
This exclusive lifetime plan includes every Notepik feature with 5 meeting hours per month, enough for about 5–10 meetings, while Notepik’s recurring Starter subscription includes 8 hours. If you hit the limit, processing pauses until the next month, with no overage charge and nothing deleted. You can export any write-up to Markdown or PDF, so your notes stay yours.
Auto-Join Meeting Bot: A visible bot joins your Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Webex calls.
Calendar Sync: Connect your Google or Microsoft calendar so the bot joins your calls.
Chrome Extension: Record a call in your browser tab with no bot in the meeting.
Recording Uploads: Process audio or video files you already have, up to 2GB each.
Action Items With Owners: Each next step comes with a suggested owner and due date.
Decision Log: The key decisions from every call are captured in one place.
Multilingual Summaries: Get summaries of meetings in 40+ languages, written in the language spoken.
Custom Summary Templates: Give sales calls, standups, and hiring interviews their own write-up format.
Work-Tool Integrations: Send action items to Slack, Asana, Trello, ClickUp, and HubSpot, or to Zapier, Make, and n8n through webhooks.
Ask With Citations: Ask questions across every past meeting and get answers that point to the exact moment something was said.
Shared Team Library: All 3 seats share one searchable library, so meeting notes are never stuck with one person.
Share & Export: Share write-ups by link, with or without the transcript, or export them to Markdown or PDF.
Web App: Any modern web browser on Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS, iOS, or Android

Supported Meeting Platforms: Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Webex
